description: Case with synthetic identifiers, including one deliberately hostile evidence pointer carrying a raw-PHI key (`cpf`) with the repo's canonical synthetic CPF canary '123.456.789-09' -- `gather`'s `_normalize_evidence` refuses this item WHOLESALE (evidencia_recusada:1), so the canary never reaches `evidencia_normalizada`/the dossier. Asserts the emitted dossier never carries the canary. The ABS check is scoped to the emitted `dossier` object (the custody-bound corpus `seal_custody_bundle` will seal), not the raw graph state, because the raw `evidencia_refs` caller-input echoes back into LangGraph's merged state regardless of the graph's own PHI-stripping logic (a whole-state scan would trivially 'fail' on any planted input value, which is not the property under test -- see test_dossier_admin_evals.py module docstring). The mutation check additionally proves the ABS assertion has teeth by injecting the canary into the LLM's own narrative output.
recorded_llm: Caso organizado a partir das evidencias validadas e dos indicadores observados; nenhuma decisao de merito e tomada neste dossie, apenas a instrucao factual para o investigador humano.
